comparison.objective: Pull a battery service plug before removing and safely tray-storing two busbars; candidate replaces a motion-control harness connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Service-plug extraction plus rigid busbar lifting and clearance management versus failed-connector extraction followed by replacement mating and cable/seal management.
comparison.success_condition: PR measures plug-out ordering, busbar motion, post clearances, tray placement, and irreversible electrical-safety failures; candidate lacks plug identity, removal/mating procedure, ordering, seal, and damage criteria.
comparison.reason: Connector extraction is shared, but the PR's central tested sequence is high-voltage isolation followed by safe busbar removal; it does not install a replacement connector.
